This is an operational/technical constraint on executing the push_route_update protected action; it does not speak to the billing dispute root cause or any of the dispute-surge hypotheses.

fact_candidates.statement: Vendor field dispatch API notice: v2 route-push endpoint was retired 2026-10-01; route pushes must use v3.

contradiction_assessment.rationale: The problem's root-cause premises (E-01..E-08) are unaffected, but any planned execution of the push_route_update protected action via the retired v2 endpoint would now fail; the integration path, not the problem, needs updating.
